name: Salköveskút (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and light grey at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Salköveskút: a blue shield with a yellow charge and a stag's head.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
